name: Harissa lamb meatballs
blurb: Smoky harissa meatballs in tomato sauce with a lemony tahini swirl.
steps: Mix lamb, 1 tbsp harissa and garlic; roll into balls.
Brown in oil, add tomatoes and remaining harissa; simmer 15 minutes.
Thin tahini with lemon and water; swirl over and add mint.

name: Miso-glazed cod with greens
blurb: Sweet-salty glazed cod with sesame greens. Use unsweetened white miso.
steps: Mix miso, aminos and ginger; spread over cod.
Grill 8–10 minutes until golden and flaky.
Steam broccoli and toss with sesame oil and seeds.

name: Crispy pork belly bites with chilli-lime dip
blurb: Shatteringly crisp pork belly cubes with a zingy dip.
steps: Rub pork with salt and five-spice.
Roast at 220°C for 30 minutes, then 180°C for 30 more.
Cut into bites.
Mix lime juice, fish sauce and chilli for dipping.

name: Beef barbacoa lettuce tacos
blurb: Slow-cooked chipotle beef, shredded and stuffed into lettuce.
ing: Lettuce, avocado, red onion to serve
steps: Rub beef with chipotle, garlic, spices and lime.
Cover with stock and cook at 150°C for 3½ hours.
Shred in the juices.
Serve in lettuce with avocado and onion.

name: Tom kha prawn soup
blurb: Hot, sour and creamy Thai coconut soup with prawns and mushrooms.
steps: Simmer coconut milk, stock, lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and prawns for 4 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and lime; top with coriander.

name: Spiced lamb and egg skillet
blurb: Cumin-spiced lamb mince with eggs cooked right in the pan.
steps: Brown lamb with cumin and garlic.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover and cook 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with sumac, parsley and chilli.

name: Cajun roasted cauliflower bites
blurb: Spicy roasted florets with a lime and coriander finish. Plant-based.
steps: Toss florets with oil and Cajun seasoning.
Roast at 220°C for 25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Finish with lime and coriander.

name: Chocolate tahini fudge
blurb: Rich, sesame-nutty freezer fudge with a pinch of sea salt.
steps: Stir everything except the salt until smooth.
Pour into a lined container and sprinkle with salt.
Freeze 1 hour, then cut into squares.
